printedClauses.clause: The ▸Dawn ability of a random character you control triggers an additional time each turn.
printedClauses.meaning: One extra named-trigger instruction each own Dawn. At resolution choose one controlled character with a Dawn-bearing ability, uniformly via random:selection. All eligible named-Dawn indexes on that physical character are admitted in order, respecting functional zones, conditions, disabling and once-per-turn. No matching character means no RNG draw/no child. The printed named ability identifies the structural Dawn-bearing pool; ordinary random-match and Dawn timing rules apply. Selection is not prefiltered by current trigger conditions, disabling, spent allowance or functional zone: a structurally matching pick can supply zero new admissions, with no retry. This is the existing explicit triggerAbility instruction at own Dawn, not repeatTriggeringAbility/captured-ordinary-occurrence replay or a static trigger multiplier. cardListener uses instanceOrigin which copies gained/lost state; originAbilities combines current own and gained definitions with sparse holes for lost groups, so gained-only Dawn candidates are handled. Recursive combined named descriptors match once per ability index, not once per branch. All printed/gained qualifying indexes are requested at instruction resolution, and ordinary current checks plus resolution-time intervening condition recheck apply.

printedClauses.clause: When you abandon a character, its ▸Dissolved ability triggers an additional time.
printedClauses.meaning: Reader is the held Dreamsign. Existing retained-abandon binding refers to the actual departed physical subject and original controller/definition. Only confirmed ordinary Dissolved admissions from that abandon supply extras; Reclaim banishment, disabled/failed/once-spent candidates do not. Existing RD616 and delivered716/717/719 apply directly.

printedClauses.clause: Draw two additional cards during your Draw phase.
printedClauses.meaning: Adds two requests after ordinary draw, counted before drawing; each held copy stacks. Entire skipped first Draw makes no requests, effect draws/opening hands are independent, ordinary Fatigue and draw triggers apply per RD617.

printedClauses.clause: At the end of each turn, discard your hand.
printedClauses.meaning: No player filter on atEndOfTurn: acts at both players Ending boundaries, before hand-limit cleanup. Resolving current holder hand size requests its whole cohort once. For emblem source discard excludes no physical hand card; full cohort is forced via autoAnswerForcedPrompts, so inventory role is existing and may be invisible.

printedClauses.clause: After you draw your opening hand,
printedClauses.meaning: Exactly one settled completion per side, after both ordinary/extra groups and energy, starting side first, before first turn. RD618 supplies empty groups, FIFO and draw-trigger suppression.

printedClauses.clause: you may discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
printedClauses.meaning: Existing confirm:youMay first; accepting offers existing chooseCards:discard min0/max current hand. One discardCards successful count drives that many normal draws, including created-card replacement count/Fatigue. Decline or empty subset has no discard batch/draw. Selection/privacy/replay/refusal are existing primitive contracts.
